Payables देय राशि (Payables)

Money a business owes its suppliers for goods or services received on credit. Also called creditors.

हिंदी में: देय राशि (Payables)

उधार पर मिले माल या सेवाओं के लिए कारोबार का आपूर्तिकर्ताओं को देय। इन्हें लेनदार भी कहते हैं।

How it is used in the lessons

Short-term borrowings and payables due within a year are current.

From How to Read a Balance Sheet

Adjust for working capital: a rise in receivables or inventory uses cash (minus); a rise in payables keeps cash in the business (plus).
